Write a dedicated atomic note comparing cross-encoder rerankers (Cohere Rerank, BGE-reranker-v2) against bi-encoder approaches used at retrieval time. The note should link to [[hybrid-search-reranking]] and explain when the latency cost of a reranker is justified.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Frontmatter complete (type: note, status: budding at minimum)
- [ ] Covers cross-encoder vs bi-encoder trade-off with latency numbers
- [ ] Covers cascade retrieval pattern (retrieve 100, rerank to top-5)
- [ ] Wikilinks to [[hybrid-search-reranking]] and [[retrieval-methods]]
- [ ] Filed as `wiki/notes/reranking-strategies.md`

## Context

The current [[hybrid-search-reranking]] note mentions reranking as a step but does not go deep. The plainkeep-search spike benchmark (`run_search_live.py`) showed that adding a reranker improved MRR@5 by ~0.12 on the test queries — worth documenting as a standalone concept.
